description: This source file defines the NumberFormat class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, responsible for managing and applying number formatting styles for spreadsheet cells, including predefined formats, custom formats, and handling built-in format codes.

classes.name: NumberFormat
classes.description: Class managing number formatting styles in spreadsheet cells, including predefined and custom formats, with support for style application and retrieval.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the NumberFormat object, optionally as a supervisor or conditional style.

methods.name: getSharedComponent
methods.description: Returns the shared NumberFormat component for the active cell in the active sheet, used for style supervisors.

methods.name: getStyleArray
methods.description: Builds and returns a style array from subcomponents, used for applying styles.

methods.name: applyFromArray
methods.description: Applies style settings from an array, updating the format code accordingly.

methods.name: getFormatCode
methods.description: Retrieves the current number format code, considering if the object is a supervisor.

methods.name: setFormatCode
methods.description: Sets the number format code; if empty, defaults to general format.

methods.name: getBuiltInFormatCode
methods.description: Returns the built-in format code if set.

methods.name: setBuiltInFormatCode
methods.description: Assigns a built-in format code by index.

methods.name: fillBuiltInFormatCodes
methods.description: Static method that initializes the array of built-in format codes and their corresponding format strings.

methods.name: builtInFormatCode
methods.description: Static method that returns the format string associated with a built-in ID.

methods.name: builtInFormatCodeIndex
methods.description: Static method that returns the ID of a format string.

methods.name: getHashCode
methods.description: Returns a hash code representing the current style, considering shared component if supervisor.

methods.name: toFormattedString
methods.description: Converts a value into a formatted string according to a specified format, using the Formatter helper.

methods.name: exportArray1
methods.description: Exports the style as an array for serialization purposes.
